name: navigation-menu
useFor: Use for a site's top navigation with grouped destinations (Product, Docs). Put NavigationMenuLink rows with a title and a muted line inside each NavigationMenuContent. Pass viewport={false} to open each panel under its own trigger. navigationMenuTriggerStyle styles a plain link as a trigger; call it from a client component.
constraints: A navigation menu inside the console's rail (use Sidebar)
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the rail's nav rows and the raised panel
